Submission Instructions

  1. Open your chosen manuscript witness image in VS Code or your IIIF viewer alongside a plain text file (ground_truth.txt).
  2. Transcribe the entire page by hand line by line, preserving original orthography, abbreviations, and line breaks.
  3. Run the same page through Transkribus (automated baseline detection and transcription) and an LLM/VLM vision prompt.
  4. Compare the outputs against your human ground truth: calculate CER, record where the machine failed (e.g. damaged ink, ligatures, margin notes), and identify any hallucinations.
  5. Submit your transcription files and a 300–500 word comparative reflection evaluating the limits of automated transcription on unique cultural artifacts.
